subject: Not hate, bored of blah blah blah!
author: SUFFUR
body:
Substance, thought, and getting involved, is good, but ‘whatever’, can get on people tits. You are entitled to your opinion; just don't preach it as gospel, because you’re not a God (not that he may exist) or a Prophet, but a man who plays Burnout. And if you read it all, it was a fun kicking, not a hate blog/comment. You do it, we can all do it? Or is that a 'tad' unfair? Have you have bashed so much that you forgotten how it feels to be the bashed? Suffur the Saviour of the Down Trodden and Boredly Bashed, plus you said I had not written anything in a while, so I did, oops did I go too far? Did some of it ring true, or as I said a bunch of diatribe, to fill my boredom? You just need to know that you crossed some people lines, mine for one, and that we can give as good as we take. And since no-one likes to say bad things, and can’t sometimes, it’s good to clear the air and draw another line in the sand for you to try and cross. I just know where I can buy some land mines, to make it harder to cross, that’s all. And yes, the Burnout games can be a bytch, to replay, especially Burnout 3 ‘Takedown’, as they are one save, one Xbox or one hard drive, in the case of the Xbox 360. And playing it again to get your Euro or World Circuit Racer can be a bugger and doing 250 takedowns to get your Assassin Super, is also a pain. Sure, use a game enhancer, to get them, since you have played the game through a couple of times but to say the all the off-line games are crap, is misinformed, lacking skill and means you’re not a Burnoutaholic, you’re a lazy sod, because the game only has to be played to get the Euro, by opening the Down Town, time trial, and GTA’ing it, and joining a friend online! 3 hours tops of easy nostalgic play though. I only need a Tuned Super to play that game, not win mind, just to play to have fun. Revenge for the 360 must have been lazy boy heaven for you, because you could go straight on line and cause the abuse.

Anyway, I don’t hate you, it’s a very strong word, just, fed up and bored, with you Bashing people and things. Curb your enthusiasm a bit, spell the odd word right so no-one misunderstands you, or misinterpreted what you are trying to get across, because so far I feel hate vibes coming from you too.

Any hew, I’ve said my piece, you jest, I jest, let’s just not turn it into a war, that turns to dribble and lowers the tone of this amazing site that we can use, with-in reason, to let off some steam, as well as write a very funny comment about you, just using my research from this site and knowing you and your fellow racers. And if was not aimed at you, you would have found it funny, maybe? And what’s so bad any way, none of its true, is it? (Scratches bearded chin in thought) …or is it?

SUFFUR THE SAVIOUR OF THE BASHED (Evil, but jesting laugh ensues, beginning with a ‘W’)

Also it takes hours for me to write this stuff, so if i put some effort in, so should you!?!(see the stress you can cause, even i have punctuation episodes) ...especially for the ill gotten addiction points you have gained.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it’s going to run out?

subject: Bootleg the Half-assed Gamer
author: SUFFUR
body:
It has come to my attention, that Boot is lacking love in his life, real love, not the one you buy with a couple of beers, and a box of condoms from the 'lav', at the local pub/nightclub/greasy spoon cafe. It has also come to my attention that he needs to gain attention, from all that witness his exploits. Here comes the mother stuff, were you not loved by her enough to have completeness that you can't complete a game. Or was it, that she mothered you, to let you be a lazy boy and that she did it all for you. You seem to be even spoilt with other things, so you think you only deserve the best of what something has to offer, skipping the hard work a gamer has to put into a game, you want the cream part of the game, forget that you have to milk the cow, process it, put some work in, but no, you would rather have a creamy moustache.

Game Shark, Genie, or other cheating devices (or game enhancers), are normally used when you hit a wall that can't be climbed because the game has stumped you, or after the game is finished to do some weird and wonderful things with the game engine. Does the off-line play stump you, can't you beat a computer A.I. driven car, or is it because, when you shout out your profanity as they beat you, they don't quit, or cry or get upset, or notice that you have a sad little gaming life, because you can only play on-line games, with people that think you are joke? Because the A.I. cars think so! you can tell by the way the sun glints of their bonnets (the hood for you Americans reading), looking like a little grin.  You're lazy, and you use your laziness to gain laughs, to hid the fact that you can't be bothered to be the best you can be, just because you have a couple of drinks does not give you the excuse to think you are the best, and sign off thinking you’re the "King of Burnout, my reign is complete and ichi's girl is mine", only in your dreams, and nightmares where the A.I. cars gang up on you and make you play Crash, with the DJ that calls out your name "BootlegGiant, does an awesome Crash folks, your tuned to Crash FM, and he can't spell".

A 'Burnoutaholic' is someone (not something) who, has played the game as it should be played, off-line and on-line to the best of their ability (and they need a number of gamer tags to prove it), and has played most of the games, the 'Burnout' canon (yes, lazy boy, look it up it’s not just a big gun)has to offer, or is it Criterion's canon? Then you'd have to have played 'Black' too? Nah, this is a Burnout web site, and you're only good at Arcady type games. Hexic 2 anyone?

You pulling up into short cuts, and stopping seems to cover up the fact you messed up a race, and know you’re going to 'lose', 'Burnout Heaven' forbid, that the great racer, BootlegGiant, is not as good as he use to be, like on Burnout 3 'Takedown', so you hide it with shinanigins(now I can't spell that, not Irish you see, or drinking Gunniess(or that) for that matter or Whiskey, though Jameson's is very, very nice). You berate people because you want to berate yourself, because you are doing shyte on an arcade racing and crashing game. You’re not happy with your job, your life, your non-existent love life, unless you count the road kill of a dead sheep (or goat for that different type of sexual partner feel?) or they way you raced today, which seems to be very half hearted, and just not as good as it was yesterday or yesteryear. Or is that why you pull over in Revenge? you've seen some digital sheep in the landscape, and are trying to phone Microsoft up to get a new attachment to the controller, so you can get at those sheep 'virtually'?

You write to your bloggy, because everyone just laughs and ignores you in real life, and as you have learned from the A.I. cars, Bloggy doesn't answer back( well it does, it is open to reply, by members of this great site, but most can't be bothered too), so it must mean all is good in 'Boot world'. You assume, that because someone has done something similar before, it can't be done again, even better, and with their own personal tastes thrown in. (see Sonic's video work, it is good, it may have be shot(filmed Boot, not with a gun) by someone else, but a film is more than just what was seen with the camera, it’s what happens after, that makes a viewing experience, and with a good editor and sound person/mixer/dj, and working with what is available, something can look better, greater and carry more meaning, than what the original intended. I like it!)

As for me changing my name, yes I was EL SUFUR (in Bastardised Mexican English it would be ‘The Pain’ because it was and is) in the early days, and some people miss my EL, but now I’m known as SUFFUR. I suffer from pain every day, due to a back injury and it is also a reflection of what I can do to others in a game, sometimes? I use to call myself a gamer, but as I have seen with the Gamer Score Whores (is that trademarked yet), I’m just a player of games. I burn the virtual rubber on Burnout games, shoot virtual holes in camera captured faces, on Rainbow Six Vegas, and have a giggle on Xbox Live Arcade, and try every demo and watch every video, that can be downloaded, from Xbox Live Market Place. (And what is it with only letting left handed movement be the default on control set-ups, for FPS and other roam around games, on demos and final releases of games? And yes I could buy a controller from some very hard working, making some money as there is a niche in the market, guy, that does do the conversions, to controllers, but what is the point of putting in your default set-up into the Xbox360 Dashboard in the first place if no game studio is going to use it?) And this web site allows me to voice some things that get on my nerves, express my views, share some news, jabber about my holiday to the Homeland, and take the piss out of you BootlegGiant. Just as you do, but I don’t swear as much as you do and I don’t make it ‘personal’ and I do use a spell checker, but I make up my own words sometimes, and they just haven’t been put in the dictionary yet, plus I like to leave some spelling mistakes to prove I am human, and to error is to learn and to have some fun on the side and give people a little laugh as they read. Plus words are just words put on a piece of paper or a VDU (visual display unit, Boot) (and walls and anywhere else there is a surface that can be scratched upon), and if you can’t read yet, you will soon learn that that’s just what they are, words. But you all cry, no there is more to words, the ‘Pen is Mightier than the sword’, so is a PEN IS, ‘Make love not War’ anyone? The point I’m trying to make with this Diatribe, Boot, is shut the f*ck up, sit back, take stock (yes play with your balls, if you got them, if not use someone else’s), and think about what you are going to say or write, just writing some rubbish does get on one’s nerves(oh hark at me the Elitist), one of the reasons I have asked you to write an article, is that you would sit down and think about it, look in to what you are going to write( that’s lots of words for the word ‘research’), if you write rubbish, you’ll get rubbish fed back, and be told off, by the Controller or his many handed helper, (that needs living things inserted, into her)? It’s all very well being a free spirit, but it’s not so free, when other people have to pay for it, by putting up with it. If you do want to get away with it set up your own web site, www..com and maybe people might  understand, what has crawled up your ass and died. Get a grip, be human, be nice and know that everyone can find you,(he lives in Wales, in England, of The Great British Isles Fame, some island off the coast of France, which is in Europe, opposite another island called Ireland,  and just across the sea what you Americans call The Pond, also known as the Atlantic, so if any of you gun hoe Americans want to drop the bomb, we will take the hit, folks, just to have one less blogger ) if you push it too far!

PS Have a nice day!

And no, it is not a real web site, but I thought about it😈, so feel free to create it, but if any money is involved I’m not giving any, and it makes some, I get 20% of the gross! 

Also i made this a comment rather than a blog, because it could have become a featured article, but you really don't need any more notoriety. Everyone has heard of you and you're Burned out life on Burnout.

Or Boot, are you just bored and a new game, like 'Burnout Paradise' will make you normal again? I know I was, so I wrote this!😉

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it’s going to run out? But you get so close to it, Master BootlegGiant.
